lastRequest: Build a fullstack Workout & Fitness Tracker with Express endpoints, Prisma database models for exercises and workout logs, and a clean dark-mode React dashboard displaying weekly progress charts, personal record badges, and interactive workout logger.

tasks.title: Database Schema and ORM Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma schema with User, Exercise, WorkoutLog, WorkoutSet, and PersonalRecord models, establish relationships, and configure connection.

tasks.title: Backend Express API Implementation
tasks.description: Implement Express server with TypeScript, CORS, environment configuration, and RESTful endpoints for exercises, active workout logging, history, and analytics aggregations using Prisma.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Architecture and UI Components
tasks.description: Set up React Vite with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and shared layout/navigation components for dark-mode fitness tracking experience.

tasks.title: Frontend Workout Logger and Exercise Library
tasks.description: Build interactive active workout session logger with live timers and set tracking, alongside searchable exercise library management interface.

tasks.title: Frontend Dashboard, History, and Analytics
tasks.description: Implement dashboard overview, chronological history viewer with expandable sets, and Recharts-based progress analytics with confetti celebrations.
